errors.evidence: The description states that the x-axis shows years from 2000 to 2022. However, the data and the axis end before 2022, approximately at the beginning of that year. The last data point represents the end of 2021 or the start of 2022, not the full year. The axis ticks also only go up to 2020.

The description states that Austria's peak in 2015 is 'just above 1.25 (≈1.30)'. Looking closely at the graph, the center of the marker for 2015 is almost exactly on the 1.25 line, not significantly above it. The approximation to 1.30 is an overestimation.
The description approximates the value for Austria in 2020 to be about 0.45. The marker is clearly closer to 0.50, at approximately 0.48.

The description states the final data point for Austria is in 2022. The data extends beyond the last tick mark of 2020, but it is not explicitly labeled as 2022. This assumes the last point corresponds to the full year 2022, which is not certain.

The description states the final data point for Germany is in 2022. The data extends beyond the last tick mark of 2020, but it is not explicitly labeled as 2022. This assumes the last point corresponds to the full year 2022, which is not certain.
